standout_why: I compared this against the two pages ChatGPT cited: Samsung CA 'Set up your Galaxy Watch with or without a phone' (updated 2026-03-20) and Apple 'Set up cellular on Apple Watch' (119601). I also checked Apple 109036, which was in its results but not cited. The Samsung CA page says only Galaxy Watch, Watch Active, Active2 and Watch3 can be set up with no phone, and that Watch4 and later need a phone. So the 'older models only' half of the finding is already partly in a rival. No result ChatGPT got names Galaxy Watch for Kids, its Watch8/7/6 LTE limit, its need for a Samsung phone, or its US carriers. None of them states the Pixel Watch rule that the watch and phone must be on the same carrier, or that TickTalk 6 can't be added to an AT&T, Verizon or T-Mobile family plan. Apple's limits for kids' watches (no international roaming, no ECG or Sleep tracking) appear only in 109036, which ChatGPT did not cite.
decides: It sorts the pick by which phone the household already has. If the wearer has no phone but a parent has an iPhone, the pick is Apple Watch SE 3 through Apple Watch For Your Kids. If a parent has a Samsung Galaxy phone, the pick is Galaxy Watch8 LTE through Galaxy Watch for Kids. With any phone at all, it is TickTalk 6, whose app runs on iPhone or Android, but it needs its own TickTalk Wireless line. The Pixel Watch 4 has no maker-documented way to run without a phone, so it only fits an adult who has an Android phone on the same carrier and leaves it at home. It also fixes two wrong cells on our page. The Galaxy Watch 8 needs Android 12 or later with at least 1.5 GB of RAM, not Android 6.0 or later. And Samsung does not allow phone-free setup on Watch4-and-later LTE models; the only route is a parent's Samsung phone in kids mode.

findings.label: Setup without a phone
findings.value: Not possible. Samsung says Wear OS models 'such as Galaxy Watch4 and later' 'require a compatible phone during the initial setup'. Phone-free setup is limited to Galaxy Watch, Watch Active, Active2 and Watch3.
findings.source_title: Set up your Galaxy Watch with or without a phone | Samsung CA
findings.note: Page updated 2026-03-20. It does not name the Watch8. It falls under the 'Watch4 and later' rule.

findings.label: Kids mode with no phone on the wearer (Galaxy Watch for Kids)
findings.value: Available on Galaxy Watch8 LTE, Watch7 LTE and Watch6 LTE. 'Requires initial pairing with a compatible Samsung smartphone' and a qualifying LTE plan (Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile at launch). Parent and child each need a Samsung Account and a Google Account with Family Link.
findings.source_title: Galaxy Watch: Now kid-ready | Samsung US
findings.note: Footnotes 1 and 2. Samsung also warns that the carrier may not support standalone voice calling.

findings.label: Phone compatibility
findings.value: Android 12.0 or higher with at least 1.5 GB of RAM, on Samsung and non-Samsung phones. Not supported on iPhone because the watch relies on Google Play services. Samsung Wallet works only with Samsung phones.
findings.source_title: Discover what phones are compatible with your Samsung smartwatch | Samsung CA
findings.note: Page updated 2026-09-11. Our page's 'Android 6.0+' is wrong.

findings.label: US supported carriers (product page)
findings.source_title: Galaxy Watch8 40mm Silver LTE SM-L325UZSAXAA | Samsung US
findings.note: Listed under 'Supported Carriers'. The page showed $299.99 for 40 mm. I did not check which variant that price belongs to, so it is not used as a price finding.

findings.label: Phone compatibility
findings.value: iPhone 11 or later, including iPhone SE (2nd generation or later), with iOS 27 or later
findings.source_title: Apple Watch SE 3 - Technical Specifications - Apple
findings.note: The iOS minimum is now 27. Our page says only 'iPhone 11 or later'.

findings.label: Apple Watch For Your Kids: requirements and exclusions
findings.value: Needs a cellular Apple Watch (Series 4 or later, or SE or later) and a parent's iPhone in the same Family Sharing group. Not available with it: international roaming, ECG, Sleep, Blood Oxygen, Wrist Temperature, Cycle Tracking, Apple Pay with a credit or debit card, and tap and wrist-flick gestures. Fall Detection and HRV need age 18+. The feature is not offered in Italy, Korea or China mainland, among other places.
findings.source_title: Set up Apple Watch for a family member - Apple Support
findings.note: Published 2026-10-27. The page's iPhone 6s / iOS 14 minimum is generic. The SE 3 itself needs iPhone 11 or later on iOS 27 (see the specs row above).

findings.label: US carriers for Apple Watch For Your Kids
findings.value: AT&T, BetterRoaming, Boost Mobile, Cellcom, C Spire, Cricket Wireless, T-Mobile USA, Verizon Wireless, Xfinity Mobile. Visible, Metro by T-Mobile, Spectrum Mobile and Consumer Cellular support Apple Watch cellular but are not on the kids list. 'Prepaid accounts and some older accounts may not be supported.'

findings.label: Same-carrier rule
findings.value: The iPhone and watch must use the same carrier, except for watches set up with Apple Watch For Your Kids. Prepaid and some older accounts are not supported. Kids' watches can't roam internationally. 5G on SE 3 needs a participating carrier.
findings.source_title: Set up cellular on Apple Watch - Apple Support

findings.label: Phone and carrier compatibility
findings.value: Android 11.0 or newer; iPhone not supported. 'For full talk, text, and data functionality, Pixel Watch and Android companion devices must use the same carrier network.' US carriers for Pixel Watch 4: AT&T, Cellcom, Google Fi, T-Mobile, UScellular, Verizon, Visible, Xfinity.
findings.source_title: Compatibility requirements & region availability for Pixel Watch - Google Help
findings.note: The page also lists a Pixel Watch 5. A Pixel Watch 4 LTE bought from the US Google Store or Best Buy gets 2 years of data and texting at no charge. The page has no update date.

findings.label: Carrier and plan limits
findings.value: For US use it requires a TickTalk Wireless plan (AT&T or T-Mobile networks). It 'cannot be added directly to an existing AT&T, T-Mobile, or Verizon family phone plan'. eSIM activation works only in the US. Plans start at $9.99/month with no contract or activation fee. The parent app is on the App Store and Google Play.
findings.note: The page has no date beyond a 2026 copyright.

findings.label: Battery (maker rating)
findings.value: 700 mAh; up to 135 h standby; about 48 h in light everyday use
findings.note: Fills our page's 'Not verified' battery cell. These are the maker's own figures.
